claim_scope: Milton zero-shot sensitivity only; not confirmatory
fixed_budget_views_semantics: total revealed views including the rolled-local initial sector 0
view_cost_semantics: 0.5 per additional reveal; the initial view has zero acquisition cost

cvian_relative_policy_fit.classifier_source: classifier state, standardizer, and frozen temperature from each attested CVIAN fit_artifact.pt
cvian_relative_policy_fit.compass_override: force NaN angle and false availability in selector_fit and validation
cvian_relative_policy_fit.origin_augmentation: for physical origin r, cyclically roll every sector-indexed cache tensor so physical r maps to local sector 0; enumerate classifier states only in the rolled local frame
cvian_relative_policy_fit.state_enumeration: all unique rolled-local subsets containing local sector 0 for k=1..3
cvian_relative_policy_fit.target: target-conditioned soft loss before minus after minus 0.5 view cost
feature_contract: revealed-sector mask relative to initial sector
relative revealed-angle mean sine and cosine
candidate sector one-hot relative to initial sector

evaluation.partial_failure_policy: a started but incomplete score consumes this registered sensitivity run; any repair uses a new version and is explicitly exploratory
evaluation.random_rng_derivation: numpy Generator(SeedSequence([model_seed, physical_origin, trajectory_index, sorted_sample_ordinal, 20260710])); sample ordinal is from ascending full sample_id, candidates are sorted rolled-local sector IDs, and Python hash is forbidden

rotation_action_contract.origin_rotation_r: cyclically roll all sector-indexed cache tensors so physical sector r is local sector 0
rotation_action_contract.tie_breaking: farthest, learned, and privileged policies choose the smallest rolled-local sector among ties
rotation_action_contract.absolute_aware_diagnostic: optional OOD diagnostic only: use unrolled physical masks/canonical candidate one-hot with compass unavailable; never use it for fit or main inference

evaluation.rotation_estimand: average each sample-policy-model-seed over all eight cyclic initial-sector rotations before macro aggregation
evaluation.averaging_order: trajectory then origin then model seed within each sample/unit before paired policy contrasts

bootstrap.purpose: descriptive uncertainty only; never a GO test
bootstrap.joint_component_construction: connected components of the dependency_group_id--spatial_block_id bipartite graph
bootstrap.pairing: retain all five model seeds, all eight rotations, and paired policies for every resampled unit

implementation_contract.attestation_chain: config hash + implementation hashes + source completion/artifact/cache/manifest hashes -> per-seed fit fingerprint -> relative artifact hash -> fit completion hash -> summary

interpretation_lock: No Milton label may influence a model parameter, calibration value, policy choice, threshold, or model selection decision.
No result is confirmatory because Milton influenced prior CrossViewGate hypothesis development and lacks observed sequence and compass metadata.
Bootstrap intervals are descriptive and cannot be converted into a GO claim.
The absolute-aware CVIAN utility model is an OOD diagnostic, not the primary transferred policy.
Max-confidence and greedy-label oracle results are privileged diagnostics only.
